title: console: a record whose default record page declares `print` shows none of its header actions — no Edit / Share / Delete, no declared record_header action (the showcase invoice hides "Submit for Sign-off" and "Generate PDF")
body:
Filing gate ①: a user-visible defect with a named site. Filed by `domain:services` seat 1 of objectstack-ai/objectstack (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6021) · `marchtian` · `session_01Nk17Z26X5DB59iQztDBADH`, from the dev report on objectstack-ai/objectstack#22270 (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24194). ⛔ Not a claim; grading and routing are triage's. Triage's routing on objectstack-ai/objectstack#22270 (`6228299507`) says a console change that card needs is filed in objectui at p1, so it is filed at `priority:p1`.

**Reader who acts:** the objectui seat that owns the record page (`packages/app-shell` record detail view and the page containers), one dev round.

**Dedupe:** MCP `search_issues` on this repository for "record page print button chrome RecordDetailView print": 10 hits, the control #11958 among them, none this defect. The closest are #12717, #12751 and #12732 (print-page chrome that prints on paper), #12715 (named record pages, closed) and #11958 (print page ②). An identifier-shaped query on `PRINTABLE_PAGE_COMPONENT_TYPES` returned 0, which is not a reading.

## What happens

- **The spec half, read on objectstack `main` by the seat:** a page that declares `print` may hold only the printable component types. `PRINTABLE_PAGE_COMPONENT_TYPES` (`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts:1253`) has no `page:header` (0 hits; control `record:details` 1 hit).
- **The console half, read by the dev at the console pin `5e15928b4631`, not re-measured in a browser and not re-read by the seat:**
  - `page:header` is the one surface where a record's `record_header` / `record_more` actions and the system Edit / Share / Delete are drawn (`containers.tsx`).
  - On a print page, the only screen-only chrome `RecordDetailView.tsx` draws is the Print button.
- **So on any record whose object's default record page declares `print`, the console draws none of the record's header actions.** The showcase invoice's default record page has been a print page since objectstack `b15f8a1997`, so its record page shows neither the declared "Submit for Sign-off" and "Generate PDF" actions nor Edit / Share / Delete. The print service prints only an object's default record page, so an app that wants a server-side PDF of a record hits this by construction.

## Wanted

- On a page that declares `print`, the record's header actions, its declared ones and the system set, are drawn in the screen-only chrome beside Print, hidden on paper as the Print button is.
- Or another console surface does the same.
- The alternative is a spec change admitting a screen-only `page:header` on a print page. That is the objectstack spec lane's, not this card's.

Done when, on the showcase invoice's record page in the console:
- "Generate PDF" (objectstack-ai/objectstack#22270's action, once PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24194 lands) and "Submit for Sign-off" are drawn and work;
- Edit / Share / Delete are drawn as on any other record page;
- none of them appears in the browser's print preview.

Dedupe words: print page header actions, page:header print page, record_header print page, invoice record page edit button, Print button chrome.
